Symmetric Jacobian spectrum yields full-norm reactivity exactly b/d>rho_n=sec(pi/(n+1)); strict gap via compact time windows. Bessel I0 upper bounds, Stirling lower sums at v=n-sqrt(n), localization v_n/n->1, prove n(kappa_n-1)/log n->1/4; two-species stationary equation gives 2.48526751266.
